load_visibility_dict: load a parquet file and convert it to a dictionary mapping scene image keys to point index lists
process_scene: process a single scene to compute object visibility across all valid images and return object-to-image mappings
process_split: process a train or val split by computing object visibility for all scenes and saving results to a pickle file
run_main: run the main function to compute object visibility for both train and val splits using configured paths
compute_object_visibility: compute the visibility percentage of each object in all valid images for a given scene using point-level visibility data
